models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

engines.hardware: NVIDIA DGX Spark (single, 128GB unified), both engines with default drafters
engines.quant: write-a-new-story round after a 67K-token prompt; Magnitude gives 50.4 tok/s (0.79x) on the same box, while on Magnitude's own copy-a-passage test Ollama is 87.2 vs 188.9 tok/s

models.why: An independent rebuild of Magnitude's '2x faster than Ollama' claim on one DGX Spark: the 2.17x holds for copying a 66K-token passage (87.2 vs 188.9 tok/s) but flips to 0.79x for writing a new story (63.4 vs 50.4), so the headline is workload-shaped rather than general.
